en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_PROGRESS_SUMMARIES` (available since 2.1.318): set it to `1` to turn off subagent progress summaries and the requests that write them (anthropics/claude-code#86879)
zh: 新增 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_PROGRESS_SUMMARIES`（自 2.1.318 起可用）：设为 `1` 可关闭 subagent 进度摘要及生成这些摘要的请求（anthropics/claude-code#86879）
